notes.title: This is Your Invitation to Participate in our Winter Contest!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

We're inviting you to participate in our Pixel Art winter contest!

[b]It starts today, December 22 at 5pm GMT+2 and it will end on Monday, December 27, at 8am GMT+2. 
[/b]
[b]Here are the rules for participating in the contest:[/b]

1. Choose an image that is winter-themed or related to the upcoming holidays; it can be something you created or a picture you've taken with your phone or camera
2. Use our Create Mode to pixelize it and color it
3. Take a screenshot, add #wintercontest in the caption and share it in the section for screenshots

[b]Note:[/b] One submission per participant is allowed.

When the contest ends, we'll choose the 3 most interesting works. [b]They will get the Pixel Art Coloring Book DLC for free. [/b]

All your submissions will be available here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1545820/screenshots/?searchText=wintercontest&browsefilter=trend&filterLanguage=default

We’re looking forward to seeing all of your works. 

Happy holidays!

notes.title: Create and Win!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We're excited to announce our brand new contest titled Create and Win! [b]It will start today, June 29 at 17 pm GMT+2 and end on Monday, July 5 at 8 am GMT+2.[/b]

To participate you need to do the following:
1. Choose an image you want; it can be something you created or a picture you've taken with your phone or camera
2. Use our Create Mode to pixelize and color it
3. Take a screenshot, add #createandwin in the caption and share it

[b]Note: [/b]Multiple submissions are allowed.

When the contest ends, we'll choose top 3 and they will get the Pixel Art Coloring Book DLC for free. 

All your submissions will be available here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1545820/screenshots/?searchText=%23createandwin&browsefilter=mostrecent&filterLanguage=default

There is no limitation to your imagination! We challenge you to test your creativity! :D 

We're looking forward to seeing all of your interesting works.

Good luck! :)

notes.title: Dark Mode and Filtering Added!
notes.notes:
Hi! 

Our new update for Pixel Art added two features that you have requested: 

- we have added the Dark mode
- we have added the option to filter the images in My Works based on whether you have finished them or not

Check out the screenshots below to see what our Dark mode looks like. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40081038/f760db2d4f153a7c86ef1d82fb96292a538f6cd0.jpg[/img]

Have a great day! :)

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Hi! 

We have just released a new update with which we have:

- improved the create mode, the max number of pixels is now 200x200
- added the pixel counter that shows you how many pixels you need to color in order to finish an image
- improved the windowed mode

We are listening to your feedback and improving our game according to it, so please let us know your thoughts about it. If you have any ideas or suggestions, leave them in the comments or write to us at support@peaksel.email. 

Have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Color Palette and Achievements Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We wanted to let you know that with our new update we have: 

- fixed the bug that was causing you trouble to switch between pages with different color palettes for images that have more than one page

- changed the conditions for the booster achievements. Now you need to use each booster only once and you'll unlock these achievements.

Thanks for playing our game and providing us with your feedback. We'll keep improving it! :)
